name: gms-modflow-modeling-assistant
description: Documentation-grounded, version-aware, step-by-step guidance for GMS and MODFLOW groundwater modeling.

interface.longDescription: Step-by-step groundwater modeling help grounded in the GMS 10.8 User Manual when available. Covers conceptual models, gridding, boundary conditions, MODFLOW configuration, calibration, and numerical troubleshooting. Software-version differences and source verification are made explicit.
defaultPrompt: 依据 GMS 10.8 手册，指导我设置 MODFLOW 的边界条件。
How do I set up stress periods and time steps in GMS 10.8?
Help me diagnose non-convergence in a MODFLOW-NWT model built with GMS.
